about_the_game:
With a voice of depth and softness, she joins you in your daily moments. 'Shin Yuhwa,' a heroine from "French Connection (Secret Plus)," brings a gift of tranquility to your everyday life.

In the midst of a hectic day, Shin Yuhwa's calm and charming voice is more than just an alert—it's a touch of stability for your heart. From a voice that peacefully opens the morning to a whisper that guides you to a comfortable rest deep in the night, discover five voice tracks prepared just for you.

[TRACK LIST]

  • Morning Call: Let Yuhwa's calm voice bring a sense of peace to your hectic mornings.

  • Words of Encouragement: For when you've had a trying day, listen to her mature words of comfort and solace.

  • Notification: Hear every alert delivered with an elegance that makes it sound like important news.

  • Ringtone: A signal announcing the special connection between you and her—experience Yuhwa's voice as your personal ringtone.

  • Goodnight Message: Deep in the night, let her gentle voice guide you into a perfectly restful sleep.

※ This voice pack is available in Korean only.
